strategy.summary: ICT's NY-open liquidity sweep (the Judas swing, the 2025 "Venom" model): in the first minutes after 09:30, price runs through an obvious pool of resting stops above or below a level set before the open, then reverses. ICT trades the reversal (fade). Independent tests disagree on direction (a walk-forward FX study found swept levels predicted continuation in 65 of 66 folds), so every setting also runs as a continuation trade with the break, as a control. Picked as rank 1 of the ICT research survey (reports/ICT strategies to backtest.md).
strategy.formula: sweep of a pre-open high/low after 09:30 → fade: close back inside, trade against it; continuation: N closes beyond, trade with it

rules.label: Level
rules.text: A range known before 09:30: overnight (18:00–09:30), Asia (20:00–00:00), London (02:00–05:00), the 08:00–09:30 box, or the prior day's 09:30–16:00 high/low. Each pre-open range needs bars for at least half its minutes.

rules.label: Sweep
rules.text: Within 15, 30 or 60 minutes of 09:30 a bar trades beyond the high (or low) by more than 0 or 0.05 × dATR (dATR = average 09:30–16:00 range of the previous 14 days). The 09:30 open must be inside the range on that side. Side: high only, low only, or whichever triggers first.

rules.label: Trigger
rules.text: Fade: the first close back inside within 1, 3 or 5 bars → trade against the sweep. Continuation: 1, 3 or 5 straight closes beyond the level → trade with the break.

rules.label: Enter
rules.text: At the open of the next 1-minute bar, one trade a session.

rules.label: Exit
rules.text: Stop beyond the sweep's extreme (+2 ticks) or 0.1 / 0.2 dATR away, never closer than 0.03 dATR, checked first within a bar. Target none, 1R, 2R, 3R or the range (a limit needing a 1-tick trade-through). Otherwise out at 11:00, 12:30 or 16:00.

rules.label: Size
rules.text: Never held overnight. As many whole GC contracts as the account covers at full contract value (no leverage), starting from $1,000,000.

strategy.length_note: Times are New York clock times. Levels use the full Globex 1-minute bars; trading uses 09:30–16:00 ET.

funnel.name: Start
funnel.why: All 648 versions backtested once on 2018–2022 data.

funnel.name: 1 · Integrity
funnel.why: Per-trade checks on every version: every pre-open level (overnight, Asia, London, 08:00 box) was recomputed from the raw Globex bars with plain loops, and the prior day's range and dATR independently; each trade's sweep, trigger, side, entry bar, stop, target and exit were re-derived; fills were never better than the market; one trade a session; nothing held overnight. Plus 40 random versions re-run on cut-off data. 0 failed.

funnel.name: 2 · Enough trades
funnel.why: Needs ≥100 completed trades and ≥10 a year in ≥4 of the 5 years. Removed 456 (456 on 1min).

funnel.name: 3 · Profit
funnel.why: Needs a net profit, Sharpe ≥ 0.75 and drawdown no worse than 30%. Removed 178 (178 on 1min); 89 of them lost money.

funnel.name: 4 · Stable settings
funnel.why: Each setting is nudged one at a time, down and up: the window by ±5 minutes, the time exit by ±15 minutes (never after 16:00), the penetration by ±0.025 dATR, confirm by ±1 bar, a dATR stop by ±0.05 and an R target by ±0.5R (structural stops and none/range targets have nothing to nudge). At least 70% of the nudged versions must be profitable, with median Sharpe ≥ 0.5. Removed 0.

funnel.name: 6 · Remove duplicates
funnel.why: Versions whose monthly returns correlate ≥ 0.8 form a group; the best 2 of each go on (a group of one keeps its one). 14 versions formed 8 groups; 14 of the 14 picks are distinct backtests.

funnel.name: 8 · Validation
funnel.why: Frozen finalists run once on unseen data: needs net > 0, Sharpe ≥ 0.3, drawdown no worse than 30% and ≥40 trades.

assumptions: Data: Databento CME continuous front month (GC.v.0), 1-minute bars from 09:30 to 16:00 ET only. Rolls are back-adjusted; positions never cross a session. The previous close is the last regular-session bar's close, not the 17:00 settlement.
Costs: 1 tick slippage per side and $2.50 commission per contract per side.

Levels come from the full 24-hour Globex bars (the session's evening bars from 18:00 belong to the next day's session). The prior day's range uses 09:30–16:00 only. A level with bars for under half its minutes is skipped for that day.

ICT definitions vary between teachers; these rules are one mechanical reading fixed before the run. The report's 432-cell grid was widened to 24,300 before any run, which makes the deflated-Sharpe correction larger.

Close to the noise-band strategy in spirit (continuation of an opening break), so what matters for adding it is its daily profit correlation with the noise-band picks, not only its own Sharpe. Measured after validation: median correlation about 0.12 (2018–2022) and 0.14 (2023–2024).
Each trade uses the whole account in whole contracts with no leverage, the same as the other families.
Sharpe uses daily mark-to-market returns (√252), with idle cash earning 0%. Time in market is the share of 1-minute bars with an open position.
Other strategy families were already selected on this market's 2023–2024 data, so 2023–2024 is not untouched; only the 2025+ holdout is.
Holdout (2025 onward) was run once for #3, #7, #11; the results are on this market's separate holdout tab.
